citations.quote: I'm up every two hours and completely wiped out at work
no damp or anything like that btw, the flat is dry, it's just the shutters
no need for any expert, just someone with the parts
a friend told me I could stop paying the rent to them and pay it into some official account instead until they fix it. if they don't do anything by end of month that's what I'll do
Vermieterin: Domicil Plus Immobilien AG, Solothurnstrasse 17, 2540 Grenchen

plan.because: The supplied contract identifies the parties, property and tenancy terms.
Obtain the report identifying the defects and when they were reported.
Establish whether and when the landlord received the defect report.
Obtain dated photographs showing the affected shutters and rooms.
Obtain the landlord's responses, proposed work and access arrangements.
Heating is not mentioned and is presumed absent for the evidence plan.
Sleep disruption and exhaustion are reported; request any medical confirmation of findings and limits of attributed cause.
The customer reports that an expert is not needed; the cause remains open unless supported.
An official rent deposit is contemplated. Request any written deadline sent to the landlord. Do not stop or redirect rent payments before the safeguards have been assessed.
This is optional under the process.

questions: When and how did you notify the landlord, and what responses or access arrangements followed?
Have you sent the landlord a written repair deadline? If so, when and how was it delivered?
Have you sought medical advice for the sleep disruption or exhaustion, and is there an immediate health or safety concern?
